narrative.overview: Midnight Atelier treats digital architecture like a physical print and industrial design practice working at dusk. Wide charcoal galleries hold unboxed photography and tactile paper-cut artwork in full scale, alternating intentionally with warm archival cream plates so dense capability matrices, engineering breakdowns, and long-form essays read with print-journal calm rather than software dashboard fatigue. Instead of decorative floating cards, fake KPI counters, or uniform bento grids, identity emerges through spatial contrast, assertive display letterforms paired with readable editorial body typography, and bespoke artwork created strictly within a disciplined five-ink studio palette. Motion stays calm, continuous, and responsive only to deliberate interaction.
keyCharacteristics: Dark charcoal ground alternating cleanly with warm archival paper reading rooms.
Bespoke paper-cut collage and architectural diagram artwork blended seamlessly onto dark and cream surfaces without browser chrome mockups.
Expansive 1360px and 1440px viewport framing with open hairline dividers replacing heavy bordered card walls.
Expressive display headlines backed by neutral sans-serif UI text and optical serif callouts strictly for essays and study theses.
Restrained botanical and warm paper accents applied functionally for orientation, active selection, and primary action.

rules.name: The Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Accent inks (Rose Pink, Garden Green, Butter Yellow) occupy under 12% of any viewport so neutral charcoal and cream surfaces establish authority first.

rules.name: The Honest Ground Rule
rules.body: Never place saturated gradient washes, neon glows, or decorative blur blobs behind headlines or cards; all sections sit on solid Midnight Charcoal, Warm Cream, or clean scrim-blended artwork.

rules.name: The Single-Emphasis Rule
rules.body: At most one typographic emphasis mode appears in any single headline; never combine gradients, dual accent colors, and italics inside the same display phrase.

rules.name: The Prose Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Extended multi-section essays and case theses shift to Newsreader serif on Warm Cream (#f8f6ef) for print-grade reading comfort.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Rest states never cast hard offset shadows; elevation is communicated exclusively through tonal surface layering, crisp hairlines, and hairline dividers.

dos: Do keep navigation items strictly single-line (<= 62px height, 76px header) with unified Start a project CTA wording across header and footer.
Do separate dense interactive UI from light Warm Cream editorial copy inside balanced 5/7 or 7/5 asymmetric splits.
Do ensure text overlapping blended illustrations always sits behind a smooth dark scrim or stops cleanly before light artwork edges.
Do render every artwork frame edge-to-edge without synthetic browser dot headers or fake SaaS invoice overlays.
donts: Don't place uppercase monospace eyebrow badges above more than one-third of sections on any route.
Don't invent placeholder performance metrics (100/100, <600ms), client testimonials, or commercial portfolio claims.
Don't nest position: fixed full-screen mobile overlays inside ancestors using backdrop-filter.
Don't duplicate identical split-header alignments across consecutive vertical sections.
